terms.gloss: a bedroom lamp: a night light
terms.comment: Martial’s title for the lamp kept by the bed. Classically it is simply a bedroom lamp; its use for a child’s night light, left burning while he sleeps, is modern, and ours.

evidence: Plaut. Most. 487: lucernam forte oblītus fueram exstinguere

phrases.english: Shall I leave the night light on?

phrases.latin: Lucerna lūcet; nihil est quod timeās.
phrases.english: The night light is on; there’s nothing to be afraid of.

phrases.latin: hic tibi nocturnōs praestābit cēreus ignēs: subducta est puerō namque lucerna tuō
phrases.english: this candle will give you light at night, for your slave has had his lamp stolen

phrases.latin: Nec in tenebrīs vigilāvit umquam nisi assidente aliquō.
phrases.english: He never lay awake in the dark without someone sitting by him.

sources: Lewis & Short: cubicularius · Lewis & Short: lucerna
